about: Fresh question pairs for evaluating the semantic cache AFTER the stronger guards were added. paraphrase_pairs mean the same thing (a cache hit is correct). different_pairs look similar but need different answers (a cache hit would be a wrong answer). Written after the guards, so only an approximate check: add your own pairs.

paraphrase_pairs.a: What is the freezing point of water in Fahrenheit?
paraphrase_pairs.b: At what Fahrenheit temperature does water freeze?

paraphrase_pairs.a: How many bones are in the adult human body?
paraphrase_pairs.b: What is the number of bones in an adult human?
Who is credited with inventing the telephone?

paraphrase_pairs.a: What is the difference between TCP and UDP?
paraphrase_pairs.b: How do TCP and UDP differ?

paraphrase_pairs.a: How do I center a div in CSS?
paraphrase_pairs.b: What is the way to center a div using CSS?

paraphrase_pairs.a: What is the capital of Japan?
paraphrase_pairs.b: Which city serves as Japan's capital?

paraphrase_pairs.a: How many seconds are in one hour?
paraphrase_pairs.b: How many seconds does an hour have?
What is the full form of HTML?

paraphrase_pairs.a: How far is the Moon from Earth?
paraphrase_pairs.b: What is the distance between the Earth and the Moon?

paraphrase_pairs.a: What is the tallest mountain in the world?
paraphrase_pairs.b: Which mountain is the highest in the world?

different_pairs.a: What is the population of India?
different_pairs.b: What is the population of China?

different_pairs.a: How do I convert binary to decimal?
different_pairs.b: How do I convert decimal to binary?

different_pairs.a: Who won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2015?
different_pairs.b: Who won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2016?

different_pairs.a: How do I sort an array in ascending order?
different_pairs.b: How do I sort an array in descending order?

different_pairs.a: What is the speed of sound in air?
different_pairs.b: What is the speed of sound in water?

different_pairs.a: How many sides does a hexagon have?
different_pairs.b: How many sides does a pentagon have?
